finding.sequence_description: Connector confusion: start SP-initiated auth targeting SAML connector, then post the SAMLResponse to a different connector callback path; must be rejected if callback is bound to the initiating connector.
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Posting a SAMLResponse to the wrong connector callback caused an HTTP 500 (server error) instead of a clean rejection (e.g., 4xx), suggesting an unhandled connector-mismatch/error path that could enable DoS or information leakage.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Posting a SAMLResponse to the wrong connector callback caused an HTTP 500 (server error) instead of a clean rejection (e.g., 4xx), suggesting an unhandled connector-mismatch/error path that could enable DoS or information leakage.

sequence.description: Connector confusion: start SP-initiated auth targeting SAML connector, then post the SAMLResponse to a different connector callback path; must be rejected if callback is bound to the initiating connector.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: The SAML callback must be bound to the initiating connector/session; posting a response to the wrong connector_id callback must not complete authentication.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse posted to a different connector callback than the one used to initiate the flow, indicating connector/session confusion.

finding.sequence_description: Step-skipping: attempt to POST a SAMLResponse to the callback without first initiating an SP flow; must be rejected (InResponseTo/state binding enforced).
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Unsolicited/step-skipped SAML POST to the ACS/callback returned HTTP 200 (appears accepted) even though no SP-initiated flow was started; should typically be rejected via InResponseTo/state binding enforcement.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Unsolicited/step-skipped SAML POST to the ACS/callback returned HTTP 200 (appears accepted) even though no SP-initiated flow was started; should typically be rejected via InResponseTo/state binding enforcement.

sequence.description: Step-skipping: attempt to POST a SAMLResponse to the callback without first initiating an SP flow; must be rejected (InResponseTo/state binding enforced).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: Dex must enforce order-preserving SP-initiated SAML flow; unsolicited/IdP-initiated SAMLResponses must not be accepted.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted an unsolicited SAMLResponse without an SP-initiated flow, indicating step-skipping / missing InResponseTo-state binding.
